symbols.name: directed graph
symbols.meaning: The directed graph, written as the pair of its vertex set V and its edge set E.
symbols.quote: A directed graph is a pair $G = (V, E)$ of a set $V$ of vertices and a set $E$ of ordered pairs of vertices.

symbols.name: vertex set
symbols.meaning: The set of vertices of the directed graph, the points that edges join.
symbols.quote: A directed graph is a pair $G = (V, E)$ of a set $V$ of vertices and a set $E$ of ordered pairs of vertices.

symbols.name: edge set
symbols.meaning: The set of directed edges of the directed graph, each an ordered pair of vertices.
symbols.quote: A directed graph is a pair $G = (V, E)$ of a set $V$ of vertices and a set $E$ of ordered pairs of vertices.
